behavior.arguments: rdi = entry pointer (saved to rax for the final byte store); rdx = first base struct; rcx = block struct. r9 = ([rcx] == 0) ? 16 : 0; block base = rcx + r9.

branch_targets.full_ja: ja at offset 0x59 (2 bytes, disp 0xf7 = -9) lands on the byte-five store at offset 0x52 (0x4e6cf62).
branch_targets.qword_jae: jae at offset 0x4d (2 bytes, disp 0x07) lands on the full-path compare at offset 0x56 (0x4e6cf66).

edges.above_full: byte 5..0x0f reaches the second test and is above 4, so no restore; the block stays zeroed.
edges.above_qword: byte 0x17 gives (0x17-0x10) = 7, not below 7, and 0x17 > 4, so no restore.
edges.below_qword: byte 0x0f gives (0x0f-0x10) wrapping to a huge unsigned value, not below 7, and 0x0f > 4, so no restore.
edges.full_boundary: byte 0x00 and 0x04 reach the second test and are <= 4, so the full saved 16 bytes are restored.
edges.qword_boundary: byte 0x10 gives (0x10-0x10) = 0 and byte 0x16 gives 6, both below 7, so only the first qword is restored and the second qword stays zeroed.
edges.unconditional: on every path: [base+0x28] = [[rdx+0xd8]+0x238], the 16 bytes at [base+0x30] are zeroed after being saved, and byte [original rdi] = 5.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with mov %rdi,%rax (no endbr64); two conditional branches (jae, ja), no loop, no calls; two ret instructions on the qword and full/no-restore paths.
behavior.return_rule: No return value claimed: on exit rax holds the original rdi argument, and the block at [base+0x30] holds the qword restore, the full restore, or zeros depending on the gate byte. The only writes are [base+0x28], the zeroed/restored 16-byte block, and the byte 5.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Exactly one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
